name: revit-mcp
description: Let Claude read and edit the Autodesk Revit model you have open: query elements, edit parameters, model walls, floors and rooms, make sheets, and see views.
long_description:
Revit MCP connects Claude to a live Autodesk Revit session (2023–2026).

**What Claude can do**
- Read the model: document info, levels, views, selection, elements by category or parameter value, full element details, family types, rooms with areas
- Edit data: set instance or type parameters in display units
- Model: levels, grids, walls and wall loops, floors, rooms, and family instances, including doors and windows hosted in walls
- Change: move, rotate, copy and delete elements
- Show and document: select and zoom, color overrides, sheets, and PNG images of any view that Claude can look at

Every change is one undo step in Revit, and Revit warnings go back to Claude instead of opening dialogs.

**Requires the free RevitMcp add-in in Revit.** Download `RevitMCP-v0.1.0.zip` from https://github.com/C-Kajanan/C-Kajanan/tree/main/revit-mcp and run `Install.cmd`, or copy the add-in for your Revit version into `%APPDATA%\Autodesk\Revit\Addins\<version>\`. Then open a model and ask Claude to "ping Revit".

The add-in only listens on localhost and rejects browser requests. Set a shared token below for extra protection.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that Revit and the RevitMcp add-in are reachable. Returns the Revit version and whether a document is open.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Summary of the active Revit document: title, path, project info, units, phase, active view and element counts per major category.

tools.name: list_levels
tools.description: All levels in the model with id, name and elevation (mm), sorted by elevation.

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: Views and sheets in the model (non-template). Optionally filter by view type, e.g. FloorPlan, Section, ThreeD, Sheet, Schedule.

tools.name: get_active_view
tools.description: Name, id, type, scale and associated level of the view currently open in Revit.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Elements the user currently has selected in Revit, with id, category, family, type and name.

tools.name: query_elements
tools.description: Find elements by category (BuiltInCategory like OST_Walls or a display name like 'Doors'), optionally limited to a view, filtered by a parameter value, and with parameters included.

tools.name: get_element
tools.description: Full details for one element: category, family/type, level, location (mm), bounding box and all instance and type parameters.

tools.name: list_family_types
tools.description: Loadable family types (FamilySymbol) and system types (wall, floor, roof types) available to place. Filter by category.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: Placed rooms with number, name, level, area (m²), perimeter (mm) and volume (m³).

tools.name: export_view_image
tools.description: Render a view (default: active view) to a PNG so you can see the model. Returns an image.

tools.name: set_parameter
tools.description: Set a parameter on an element. String values are parsed in the project's display units (e.g. '3000' for a length in a mm project, '3 m', or text). Numbers set the raw value in Revit internal units (feet, radians).

tools.name: create_level
tools.description: Create a level at an elevation (mm) and optionally create a matching floor plan view.

tools.name: create_grid
tools.description: Create a straight grid line between two plan points (mm).

tools.name: create_wall
tools.description: Create a straight wall between two plan points (mm) on a level. Uses the default wall type if wallType is omitted.

tools.name: create_walls_from_polyline
tools.description: Create a chain of walls through a list of plan points (mm). Set closed=true to close the loop, e.g. for a room outline.

tools.name: create_floor
tools.description: Create a floor from a closed boundary of plan points (mm) on a level.

tools.name: place_family_instance
tools.description: Place a family instance (furniture, equipment, columns, doors/windows in a host wall, etc.). For doors and windows, pass hostWallId and a point on that wall.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Place a room at a plan point (mm) inside bounding walls on a level, with optional name and number.

tools.name: move_elements
tools.description: Translate elements by a vector in mm.

tools.name: rotate_elements
tools.description: Rotate elements about a vertical axis through a plan point (mm) by an angle in degrees.

tools.name: copy_elements
tools.description: Copy elements offset by a vector in mm. Returns the new element ids.

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.description: Delete elements (and anything that depends on them). Returns all ids that were removed.

tools.name: select_elements
tools.description: Set the selection in the Revit UI and optionally zoom the active view to it.

tools.name: color_elements
tools.description: Override element colors in a view (default: active view) to highlight them. Pass reset=true to clear overrides.

tools.name: create_sheet
tools.description: Create a sheet with a title block and optionally place views on it.

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: Port the RevitMcp add-in listens on. Change it only if you set REVIT_MCP_PORT for Revit too.

token.title: Shared token (optional)
token.description: Only needed if you set the REVIT_MCP_TOKEN environment variable for Revit. Must match it.

timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Revit to answer. Revit only answers when it is idle.
